event_section.hydrographic_context: Lower Idice, embanked reach at San Martino in Argine

network_status.summary_it: Il sensore entrò nella finestra di misura durante la crescita della piena e fu poi travolto dal crollo del ponte.
network_status.summary_en: The sensor entered its measurement window during the rising flood and was then swept away with the bridge collapse.

reference_station.name: Idice a S. Martino in Argine

sources.title: Ripristino della stazione idrometrica di San Martino in Argine

curation_note.it: 14,36 m è il limite superiore della finestra strumentale superata, non il colmo effettivo. La stazione era installata sul ponte e fu distrutta con il collasso; non viene ricostruita la parte mancante dell’idrogramma.
curation_note.en: 14.36 m is the exceeded upper limit of the measurement window, not the actual peak. The station was installed on the bridge and was destroyed with the collapse; the missing hydrograph is not reconstructed.

provenance.method: Manual extraction from the official validated event report and station-restoration record

caveats: The reported greater-than 14.36 m value is a lower bound because the actual peak exceeded the instrument measurement window.
The stage is relative to the station gauge datum and is not water depth or absolute elevation.
The station and its incomplete hydrograph were lost with the bridge collapse.
No discharge is assigned because no validated event-specific stage-discharge conversion is provided here.
The hydrometric observation documents loading context and does not alone establish the complete collapse mechanism.
